fishsupper_cook.text: Fish and chips, Dingle style. The fish was in the bay this morning. The chips were in a field this week.
Dingle's Irish name is An Daingean, which means 'the stronghold'. The Irish is still spoken in the shops, on the signs and on the street.
A tip: the gulls on the harbour wall know all about chips. A Chipgull will have your supper if you look away.
